submission.justification: Absorber-F3 with 6mm plate thickness delivers the best energy resolution of 3.197% at 100 GeV across all tested configurations. This represents a 15% improvement over the best F2 configuration (3.757% at 4mm) and a 37% improvement over the best F1 configuration (5.041% at 4mm). The systematic scan of plate thicknesses from 2-10mm for all three materials confirms that F3 at 6mm is the optimal choice for achieving the goal of best possible energy resolution. The material meets all operational constraints including hands-on maintenance requirements during shutdowns.
